User.title: User Profile
User.description: A document representing a registered student's profile information.

uid.description: The unique reference UID of the authenticated Firebase user.

email.description: The registered email address of the student.

displayName.description: The custom profile name displayed inside the app header.

photoURL.description: An optional URL pointing to the user's avatar image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp showing the last time profile data was synchronized.

PracticeProgress.title: MCQ Practice Progress
PracticeProgress.description: Data record tracking answered questions and accuracy metrics across mock/practice exams.

userId.description: The owner user ID matching the parent account document.

practiceProgress.description: A serialized map of question keys with answer attempts and correctness values.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last synchronized progress attempt.

FlashcardsProgress.title: Flashcards Learning Progress
FlashcardsProgress.description: Progress tracking details for formulas and framework card assessments.

userId.description: The owner user ID matching the parent account document.

flashcardPerformance.description: A serialized map indicating user understanding of formula flashcards ('known' or 'learning').

frameworkCardAssessments.description: A serialized map of strategic theoretical framework assessment rankings ('Hard', 'Medium', 'Mastered').

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last rating update.

UserNotes.title: User Notes & Scribble Pad Info
UserNotes.description: Sticky annotations and full scribble pad text saved by the student.

userId.description: The owner user ID matching the parent account document.

caseNotes.description: Sticky notes annotated alongside RTP/MTP booklet cases.

globalNotepadText.description: The full body markdown text of the global floating scribble pad.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest note-pad sync or autosave.

/users/{userId}/progress/practice.description: User-specific MCQ answers and accuracy tracker.

/users/{userId}/progress/notes.description: User-annotated sticky notes and scratch text.
